title: Document that an SSH remote's ~/.ssh/config Host stanza must match the configured host literally (an alias-only stanza does not apply)
outcome: docs/features/project-scoped-remotes.md states that TermAl connects to `<user>@<host>` exactly as configured on the Remotes entry (src/remote_ssh.rs remote_ssh_target), so ssh options such as IdentityFile, IdentitiesOnly and StrictHostKeyChecking apply only from a ~/.ssh/config Host stanza whose pattern matches that literal host. An alias-only stanza (e.g. `Host pilot-mac`) is ignored. It gives the working pattern: list both the alias and the IP or hostname on the Host line.
acceptance: project-scoped-remotes.md documents the literal-host matching behaviour, with a working `Host <alias> <ip>` example and the failure symptom (an initial proxy creation failure / authentication refusal with BatchMode).
The statement is verified against src/remote_ssh.rs remote_ssh_target and remote_ssh_command_args at the docs revision, with file:line in the review.
